text:
nina: Hey @eng-infra, struggling to run my first CI build — Buildkite shows 'Agent unauthorized' and GH Actions check 'ci/buildkite: permission denied'. I followed the onboarding doc but still blocked. Logs:
```
remote: error: insufficient scope
buildkite-agent: token invalid
```
Anyone pointers?

devon: Welcome! Can you paste the full build URL? Also which onboarding path did you follow (org repo vs personal)?

nina: https://buildkite.com/redwood/backend/pipelines/first-build/builds/5
I ran `bk bootstrap` from quickstart and added my SSH key. I think token wasn't created.

devon: Ok. Two common issues: (1) you need to be in the 'ci-team' GitHub org team for the Buildkite GitHub App to grant webhooks and commit statuses, (2) your Buildkite agent token may not have been created — check `buildkite-agent tokens list` on the admin console or DM me and I'll add you. If using the GitHub App, an org admin needs to approve repo access.

sam: Also our onboarding script sometimes skips adding the repo to the GitHub App if you used the 'fork' repo path. Can you run `curl -H 'Authorization: token $GH_TOKEN' https://api.github.com/repos/redwood/backend/installations` to see if the app is installed for that repo? If unsure, ping @alyssa (org admin).

nina: Ran the curl — no installation found. @alyssa can you take a look? Also Buildkite shows this when I try to trigger: 
```
curl: (22) The requested URL returned error: 403
buildkite: failed to enqueue job: unauthorized
```

infra-bot: buildkite:build-5 failed (removed agent) — automatic retry scheduled in 10m. Incident #INC-2025-71

alyssa: On it — I can approve the GitHub App for that repo. @nina I'll add you to ci-team and re-run the install. Heads up for admins: we require 'Contents' and 'Metadata' permissions.

devon: Once Alyssa adds the app, go to Buildkite > Pipeline Settings > General > 'Authorized GitHub Applications' and re-authorize if needed. Then trigger with `/run pipeline: first-build` or click rebuild.

nina: Thanks all. Quick question — where do we note these steps for future hires? The onboarding doc didn't mention the GitHub App edge-case.

sam: Add a short checklist to the onboarding doc: (1) confirm GH App installed, (2) run bk token create, (3) request ci-team membership. PR to infra/docs-onboarding.md accepted quickly.

alyssa: Done — added checklist and link: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/blob/main/docs/onboarding.md#ci
I also installed app and added nina. Try again.

nina: Re-ran `bk bootstrap` and retriggered build — build succeeded! :tada: Thanks for the quick help.

devon: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with a short runbook in the eng-infra channel and tag ops so we can automate the install step later.

nina: closing thread — saved the checklist in my notes. Appreciate the help!
